profile_fsdp_operations: profile FSDP all_gather, resharding, and host-to-device operations with SimpleProfiler
reset_simple_profiler: reset SimpleProfiler timing results and profiling state for a new measurement cycle
dump_profiler_results: dump SimpleProfiler timing results as a warning log and reset counters
get_sharded_module_tree: get a sharded module tree string showing FQDNs and FULLY SHARDED status for an FSDP model
map_module_fqns: map each sharded module name to its managed parameter FQNs in an FSDP model
